name: UQ Refugee and Humanitarian Scholarship
summary: Full tuition waiver and living stipend for UQ coursework students on temporary protection, humanitarian or related bridging visas.
key: 100% tuition fee waiver, plus $29,000 annual living stipend.
who: Enrolled or enrolling in an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program at UQ.

Hold a Temporary Protection (785), Safe Haven Enterprise (790), Temporary Humanitarian Concern (786) or Temporary Humanitarian Stay (449) visa, or a Bridging Visa E or A after applying for one of these.
Can demonstrate financial hardship with documents.
Not previously received it at the same level, and not holding a similar scholarship.
how: Apply using the online application form with your visa, CV, UQ offer letter, financial evidence and a personal statement.
catches: Applications expected to open late October 2026 and close December 2026.
